title: Ads on a single channel
question: Do we concentrate the ad budget on one channel?
actual: €3.60, on target. But 55% of leads now depend on one channel.

frame.problem: Spreading a small ad budget across channels gave no usable signal. Do we concentrate it on one channel?

vars.name: Readable cost-per-lead signal
vars.ctx: We need enough volume on a channel to read its cost per lead within 2 weeks.

vars.name: Budget
vars.ctx: The monthly ad budget is fixed for the quarter.

vars.name: Dependence on one channel
vars.ctx: One channel means one algorithm change can cut lead flow overnight.

opts.name: One channel
opts.desc: The whole budget on the channel with the best early CPL.
